answer: Each identity must complete one change-ringing peal: eight ringers ring a 5,040-change peal, logged by the captain, three hours, no false change. One peal backs one identity; the register rejects a second claim on the same peal or ringer; a willow marks the fixed site. Each peal costs 900 units and 180 days of practice; 100 fakes cost 90,000 units, 100 bands, a nebula of towers. Cheapest cheat: hire a band to ring under a false name. The ringers surrender the peal backing their own identities; one false change echoes through the log, exposing the cluster and voiding every tied identity.
